canvas.hint: Drag to pan · Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom
canvas.helpBody: Drag with the left or middle mouse button, one finger, or a pen to pan. Scroll to pan; Shift + scroll moves horizontally. Ctrl/⌘ + scroll or a two-finger pinch zooms around the pointer. With the canvas focused: arrow keys pan (Shift for larger steps), +/− zoom, 0 resets zoom, and Home fits content. Tab leaves the canvas. Expand canvas fills the application window; restore it with the same button.
canvas.snapHelp: Grid spacing is measured in world units. At low zoom, the visible grid becomes coarser. Snap keeps the configured spacing independently of grid visibility; this setting prepares future element editing and does not snap canvas navigation.
canvas.preview: Read-only geometry preview. Shapes, styles, assets, and specialized content may look different; all original project data is preserved.
canvas.limited: Dense view: preview limited to 1,500 visible nodes and 1,500 connections. Zoom in to see more detail. All elements remain in the project.
canvas.adjusted: This saved view exceeds navigation limits. A bounded view is displayed; the original view stays unchanged until you navigate.
canvas.future: This page uses newer view settings. Navigation is temporary; its saved view and settings remain unchanged.
